description: When a task needs a human (booking, negotiating, an IVR menu, information from a business), send an AI voice agent to make the call. It follows your instructions, holds a real two-way conversation and returns the transcript with a structured analysis. Requires create_payment with toolName='ai_call', phoneNumber and durationMinutes; priced per destination and duration: create_payment returns the exact amount before you pay. Async: poll check_job_status(jobType='ai-call'). May return state='pending_confirm' with questions when critical info is missing: call confirm_ai_call to proceed. One redial, 2 minutes later, if nobody answers, a voicemail answers, the line is busy or the call drops within 30 seconds. No redial after the person speaks and hangs up, asks to stop or opts out, or after the agent leaves a voicemail message. A person who asks not to be called again is added to our do-not-contact list. The redial runs on the deposit's unused minutes (none left: no redial), and a connected redial bills at least 1 minute. Not for: your own LLM driving the call (open_voice_bridge), a one-way spoken message (place_call), SMS (send_sms). The agent says it is a virtual assistant calling for a client, and answers questions about the service if the recipient asks. At the end of a normal call it asks the recipient for permission to share the recording; without a clear yes, the recording is deleted and never returned. No impersonation, scams, threats, harassment, credential theft, unsolicited bulk messages, or contact after an opt-out. Answering a call does not establish consent. We screen requests after payment. Held messages and calls are not sent or placed; payment is retained during review, not refunded immediately. Confirmed violations are not refunded. Unresolved communication holds become eligible for a refund after 24 hours; refund eligibility is processed by scheduled maintenance. Human review costs 1 sat at https://sats4ai.com/appeal. What we keep, and for how long: https://sats4ai.com/terms

beginMessage.description: Optional opening line for the agent

language.description: Language the agent should speak to the called party. Pass this when you know the destination's preferred language (e.g. calling a French pizzeria → fr-FR, a Japanese restaurant → ja-JP). If omitted, we guess from the destination country: +33 → fr-FR, +49 → de-DE, +34 → es-ES, etc. Bilingual regions (Canada, Belgium, Switzerland, Singapore) and unknown countries default to en-US — override explicitly when you need a non-English language in those regions. Voice is auto-selected per language.

refundAddress.description: Lightning address of YOUR user (for example name@wallet.com), only if the user gave you one. Never invent or guess an address: the refund is paid out at once and cannot be called back. The unused deposit is sent here when the call ends. With no address, or if that payment fails, the refund waits as an LNURL-withdraw link.

task.description: Instructions for the AI agent (what to say, ask, or accomplish)
